$comment: Our own structuring of OP-XY MIDI facts. Not affiliated with Teenage Engineering. Every entry has confidence + source keys (see `sources`). Channels are 1-based; values 7-bit unless noted.

verifiedOnDevice: USB/port enumeration (one in/out pair named OP-XY)
MIDI echo default on (foreign SysEx echoed, TE frames not)
screen-profiled CC reach of every page (docs/research/59-screen-profiling.md §3)
firmware.note: CCs verified on 1.1.33 carry verifiedOn (probe log and camera captures); see each entry and doc section 11

confidenceLevels.verified: observed on the owner's OP-XY (OS 1.1.33, 2026-09-26) by the lead agent's read-only probe (docs/research/90-device-probe.md)
confidenceLevels.official: stated on teenage.engineering (guide, MIDI reference, changelog, TE updater code)
confidenceLevels.community-verified: >=2 independent community sources, or tooling clearly run against hardware
confidenceLevels.community: one community source (or several that copy each other); plausible, unconfirmed
confidenceLevels.derived: inferred by us from structural consistency across sources; testable prediction
confidenceLevels.speculative: educated guess; treat as unknown until probed

sideEffects.scene: active scene / mix state (stored in scenes)
sideEffects.destructive: may load/create/delete data or trigger arbitrary UI actions

activeTrackChannel.semantics: notes received on this channel play the currently selected track (in addition to normal routing)
activeTrackChannel.recommendation: move it off channels 1-8 to a channel the agent never sends on (all 16 map to tracks) or off if offered

projectTrackChannels.semantics: output channel for a track's sequenced notes; effect on receive routing unknown

mtpExclusive.semantics: MIDI unavailable while the device is in MTP mode; the normal-mode USB descriptor has no MTP interface

usb.interfaces: UAC1 audio in + out, one USB-MIDI streaming interface

echo.consequence: input handlers must drop echoes of our own output; never forward input to output

laneModel.description: Per-track CC numbers address encoder lanes in module order. dark/mid/light/white = the four encoders.

pages.page: M2 alt (filter envelope; click an encoder)

global.name: tempo
global.semantics: BPM = 2 × value, clamped by the device to 40–220 (values 0–20 → 40, 110–127 → 220); 2-BPM resolution. Verified 2026-09-26: 0/32/60/64/96/127 → 40/64/120/128/192/220 BPM (device clock + metronome page); tempo page: big BPM number, the metronome weight slides down its arm as BPM rises (top at 40, bottom at 220) (DEVICE-CAMERA)

candidates.note: code comment: 'calibrated slope of 2 BPM per unit'

global.name: groove amount
global.semantics: groove amount, a slider under the metronome on the tempo page: 0 far left, 64 centred, 127 far right (screen-verified 1.1.33, note 59 §2.11); midi.guide gives 63 as no groove; clockwise of centre = swing, counter-clockwise = shuffle (guide)

global.name: scene (delayed switch)
global.semantics: 0-98 -> scene 1-99, switches after the next bar (community); command added in 1.1.0

global.name: scene (immediate)
global.caution: UI rule: switching to an empty scene duplicates the current scene (TE-ARR); unknown for MIDI - target existing scenes only

global.name: project
global.semantics: 0-127 -> loads the project whose filename carries that 3-digit number: prefix per xy-format test tool, suffix per midi.guide/opxy-reactive
global.caution: loads another project; repeated requests crashed firmware before 1.0.40; never automate

global.name: master EQ
global.semantics: band selected by channel: CC90 on channels 1-3 tilts the low / mid / high panel group on mix M2 (flat at 0, upright at 127; 64 in a new project), screen-verified 1.1.33; on channel 4 (blend) it moved nothing visible (DEVICE-CAMERA)

1.note: screen-verified 1.1.33: tilts the low panels on mix M2 (DEVICE-CAMERA); confidence left as it was because src/lib/core/opxy/ccmap.spec.ts pins it; raise it to verified together with that test

2.note: screen-verified 1.1.33: tilts the mid panels on mix M2 (DEVICE-CAMERA)

3.note: screen-verified 1.1.33: tilts the high panels on mix M2 (DEVICE-CAMERA)

4.note: official lists channel 4; opxy-reactive reports no working CC for blend; on 1.1.33 CC90 on channel 4 moved nothing visible on mix M2 (DEVICE-CAMERA) - audio effect untested

global.name: track select
global.semantics: 0-7 -> tracks 1-8 (zero-based; verified: value 2 selected track 3, 0 selected track 1), 8-15 -> aux tracks 9-16 (aux untested)

global.name: play
global.semantics: value 127 starts playback (verified; the device then sends FA); 0xFA does the same

global.name: stop
global.semantics: value 127 stops playback (verified; the device then sends FC); 0xFC does the same

global.name: remote key down
global.notes: firmware dependent; only channel 1 ever used; NO EFFECT on OS 1.1.33 (verified 2026-09-26: keys 2 and 51 on channels 1 and 16)

global.name: remote key up
global.semantics: releases the key pressed with CC106 of the same value; the older 'view tempo page' reading is key-up of index 1
global.notes: NO EFFECT on OS 1.1.33 (verified 2026-09-26: keys 2 and 51 on channels 1 and 16)

perTrack.semantics: 0-127; moves the track's level line on mix M1 (screen-verified 1.1.33 on track 3, note 59 §2.10)

perTrack.name: track pan
perTrack.semantics: 0-127, centred (64 ~ centre, community); moves the pan dot along the bottom of the track's column on mix M1 (screen-verified 1.1.33 on track 3)

params.name: amp attack
params.semantics: Moves the peak handle right along the top (0: at the start, 127: 115 px in); screen-verified 1.1.33 (note 59 §2.2)

params.name: amp decay
params.semantics: Moves the decay end right of the peak (127: 101 px past it); screen-verified 1.1.33

params.name: amp sustain
params.semantics: Raises the sustain level, linear, from the axis (0) to the top (127); screen-verified 1.1.33

params.name: amp release
params.semantics: Release is a handle position: 0 starts it 107 px before the end (the longest), 127 puts it on the end (none), so higher is SHORTER; screen-verified 1.1.33

params.name: filter env attack
params.semantics: Filter envelope attack, as CC20; sets the filter envelope whichever envelope M2 shows; screen-verified 1.1.33
